questions.stem: If a disease killed most of the rabbits in a food web, what would most likely happen to the fox population?

options.text: It would increase because foxes would have less competition
It would decrease because foxes would have less food
It would increase because foxes would eat more plants

questions.explanation: If the rabbit population decreased, foxes would have less food available. This would lead to increased competition among foxes, and the fox population would likely decrease.
